name: Transportation Network Optimization
description: Graph theory, transportation network representation; shortest path, label setting and label correcting algorithms; computational complexity; minimum spanning tree, Prim’s and Kruskal’s algorithms; maximum flow problem, augmenting path algorithm, max-flow min-cut theorem; minimum cost network flow problem, network simplex algorithm; linear programming in transportation engineering, properties of linear programs, graphical solution, and simplex algorithm; duality theory, complementary slackness, and sensitivity analysis; integer programming formulations of transportation problems, conditional constraints, branch-and-bound and approximate methods; traveling salesman problem and vehicle routing problem (VRP), heuristic methods for VRP; computer programming and solvers to implement solution method.
